title: Wavenumber-explicit stability and preasymptotic error analysis of UPML finite element method for obstacle scattering problems
summary: This paper develops a wavenumber-explicit stability and preasymptotic error analysis for finite element approximation of the two-dimensional Helmholtz scattering problem with a uniaxial perfectly matched layer (UPML) truncation. The analysis is based on direct estimates of the stretched Green kernel associated with the Cartesian complex coordinate transformation. We establish explicit stability for the truncated UPML problem.
